name: Hollow World-Wound Behemoth
lore: A massive mobile Gate wound used for seasonal Hollow Breach events; it is not summoned, it arrives where too many victories leave unburied memory.
visualDescription: Colossal negative-space beast with gate arches as ribs, cities of ash under translucent hide, maskless skull horizon, white storm fractures.
mapBehavior: Seasonal world boss that changes terrain, spawns anchors, and tests multiple divine archetypes.

scaling.campaign: Fixed mission bands; old wins should become easier as Divine Level and gear rise.
scaling.eliteRemix: +12% hp, +10% damage, +1 mechanic layer, +1 tactical AI priority.
scaling.endgame: Dynamic scaling is capped at player effective level +8; adds mechanics before raw hp.
scaling.levelFormula: hp = baseHp * (1 + 0.045 * missionLevel); damage = baseDamage * (1 + 0.035 * missionLevel), capped by tier budget

aiProfile.counterplayWindow: Every major action has a telegraph or setup turn unless spawned as a minor swarmer.

balanceNotes: Harder solo tuning: World Boss CHAMPION pressures one active deity through behavior first, stats second; threatWeight 12.0 controls encounter budgets.
